_comment: TCMS mapping: milestone = release (NDB-2.12), requirements = project key (FEAT-xxxxx). See HAR + tcmsService.js

metrics.description: Per-FEAT pass/fail rollup (from your HAR drill-down). time_filter: all | four_weeks. target: {milestone}-qcow2.
metrics.response: { total, data:[{ _id, total, run, passed, failed, manual_run, manual_passed, manual_failed, automation_run, automation_passed, automation_failed, average_total_op_success_percentage, average_run_op_success_percentage, average_manual_op_success_percentage, average_automation_op_success_percentage }], success }

milestoneAggregate.description: Per-FEAT list filtered by milestone + requirements (Jira key) only

testResults.description: Last results for specific test_case.name set (from HAR)

fieldMapping.milestone: release / fixVersion  e.g. NDB-2.12  (TCMS target_milestone / milestone param)
fieldMapping.requirements: project key       e.g. FEAT-18520 (TCMS test_case.metadata.requirements / feats param)

callSequence: 1. POST {baseUrl}{auth.endpoint} -> { token, token_type, expiry } (refresh JWT; cache until expiry-5m)
2. For each FEAT key in release: GET {baseUrl}{endpoints.qualityIndex.path}?milestone={milestone}&feats={featKey} [+ repeat with milestone=master] (parallel, max concurrency=5)

3. Fallback if QI null: POST {baseUrl}{endpoints.milestoneAggregate.path} and {endpoints.milestoneAggregate.totalPath} with body [{"$match":{"$and":[{"target_milestone":"{milestone}"},{"test_case.metadata.requirements":"{featKey}"},{"test_case.deprecated":false}]}}] -> counts

3b. Time-windowed (Last 4 weeks): GET {baseUrl}{endpoints.metrics.path}?aggregation_field=test_case.metadata.requirements&time_filter=four_weeks&target={milestone}-qcow2&feat_type=all&filters={...} -> run/passed/failed for last 4 weeks only.
4. Assemble { qi, overallQI, featureQI, teams/components, date, master, branch } + build uiLink template -> attach as item.tcmsQI + item.tcmsQueryUrl
5. (On drill-down) same milestone+requirements POST -> paginated test-cases
